metadata.description: Agent skills for the Karma ecosystem — manage projects, grants, milestones, and discover funding opportunities

plugins.name: Find Funding Opportunities
plugins.description: Search the Karma Funding Map for grants, hackathons, bounties, accelerators, VC funds, and RFPs

plugins.name: Project Manager
plugins.description: Create and manage projects, grants, milestones, and updates on the Karma protocol

plugins.name: Funding Program Manager
plugins.description: Manage funding programs — reviewers, applications, milestones, payouts, grant agreements, and AI evaluation

plugins.name: Skill Creator
plugins.description: Create new Claude Code skills for the Karma ecosystem

plugins.name: Simocracy Evaluations
plugins.description: Let a program's Simocracy Sims evaluate an application or its delivered milestones and save each Sim's verdict on Karma as a private draft that reviewers comment on and publish

plugins.name: Simocracy Milestone Evaluations
plugins.description: Deprecated: renamed to Simocracy Evaluations, which evaluates applications as well as milestones

plugins.name: Manage Portfolio Reports
plugins.description: Build a community's portfolio report from Karma data, show it for approval, save it as a draft and publish on request; find, edit and unpublish reports

plugins.name: Application Pre-Review
plugins.description: Prepare a reviewer brief for a funding application: data checks on track record, funding and timeline, the concerns reviewers usually raise and the questions to ask the applicant. Read-only, no verdict
